instructions: Step do: Do the work in this session, citing what was read.
This step may act at project_write; the gate has already been passed for exactly this step.
Return an object with: summary, findings, changes, artifact.
It will be checked by: citations_present, evidence_refs_resolve, excerpts_match, within_period, named_sources_read, numbers_grounded, artifacts_exist, deliverable_complete, no_placeholder_facts.

citations_present needs evidence entries whose ref names a real project file (docs/a.md), a deliverable, or an item a recorded read holds (PLAT-101, confluence:98765, or the page's url); record what you read with sources action report before citing it.
evidence_refs_resolve rejects any evidence ref that names nothing this project holds.

excerpts_match needs every evidence excerpt to appear in the file or item it cites (case and spacing do not matter); an excerpt from something Construct holds no text for is not checked and supports nothing.

within_period refuses a cited item whose recorded updatedAt falls after the period this run covers ends; an item that belongs anyway passes when the output lists it under "outsidePeriod" as {ref, why}. Items last updated before the period, items with no date, and project files pass and are counted in the deliverable.

named_sources_read needs, for each source this run names, a cited item, file or folder read from it (cite it as <source>:<item>; naming the whole source does not count); a named source you could not read passes when the output lists it under "unread" as {source, why}.

numbers_grounded rejects any figure in the output, or in a document this step wrote (an artifact or changed file that is .md, .txt, .html, .csv and the like; code and configuration are not read for figures), that no cited source contains; a figure counts only when it is in text Construct holds (a file, or what you recorded reading), never in a document this step wrote, and a code or configuration file you changed may be cited for the values it now holds; an excerpt alone does not ground it. List computed figures under "derivations" as {value, expression}, where expression is arithmetic over cited figures.

artifacts_exist needs "artifact" (or "changes") naming the file you wrote, and that file must exist and not be empty; a step whose outputs include "changes" may list none ("changes": [], "artifact": null).
deliverable_complete needs a non-empty "summary" and one of "findings", "body", or "decisions".
Cite every source you read as evidence entries.

intake.title: Intake
intake.useWhen: Turns a long, messy, nonlinear request into one structured brief: what is actually being asked, the constraints, what was already decided, the open questions.

adversarial-review.title: Adversarial review
adversarial-review.useWhen: Challenges a finished deliverable, plan, or decision before anyone commits: the strongest case against it, the failure it hides, the assumption doing the work.

context-mapping.title: Context mapping
context-mapping.useWhen: Maps an unfamiliar system before anyone acts in it: the parts, who owns what, what depends on what, the boundaries, and the unknowns, each with how it was observed.

decision-framing.title: Decision framing
decision-framing.useWhen: Frames a decision that will be expensive to reverse: the options, the trade-offs, the strongest objection, a recommendation.

experience-design.title: Experience design
experience-design.useWhen: Reviews or reshapes an interface or flow for whether people succeed in it: task completion, findability, error states, accessibility, and fit with the design system.

governance-risk.title: Governance and risk
governance-risk.useWhen: Spots compliance, legal, contractual, and financial exposure in plain language: what rule or obligation applies, what the evidence is, what a licensed professional must settle.

investigative-research.title: Investigative research
investigative-research.useWhen: Establishes what is actually true from primary sources and records: claims checked against evidence, timelines reconstructed, provenance kept.

operations-reliability.title: Operations and reliability
operations-reliability.useWhen: Reviews how a service or change behaves at night: objectives, alerts, on- call, runbooks, capacity, failure and recovery.

product-management.title: Product management
product-management.useWhen: Reviews or shapes a product decision: the problem, who has it, what changes for them, how it will be measured, what is cut.

program-delivery.title: Program delivery
program-delivery.useWhen: Reviews a plan, schedule, or status for claims that cannot all hold: dates against dependencies, owners against capacity, risk against who is holding it.

requirements-structuring.title: Requirements structuring
requirements-structuring.useWhen: Turns a settled intent into requirements a team can build and test from: scope, behaviour, acceptance, what done looks like.

security-privacy.title: Security and privacy
security-privacy.useWhen: Defensive review of threat model, access, secrets, data handling, and privacy, with fixes.

software-engineering.title: Software engineering
software-engineering.useWhen: Reviews or shapes an implementation for correctness evidence, scope, reversibility, dependencies, and operability.

strategy-research.title: Strategy and research
strategy-research.useWhen: Reviews a strategy against the work and capacity it actually directs: what was decided, what teams are doing, where they diverge, and what the gap costs.

system-architecture.title: System architecture
system-architecture.useWhen: Reviews or frames a system design for boundaries, coupling, data ownership, and failure paths.

written-voice.title: Written voice
written-voice.useWhen: One plain, direct house voice for prose: what it says, for whom, and nothing decorative.
